snippet.title: Dark Craft - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Dark Craft trailer for this upcoming MMORPG Souls-like game. In Dark Craft, explore an open world filled with ruined castles, forgotten temples, and enemies waiting for their prey. Play solo or with friends, hunt bosses, join guilds, fight other players, and prove your right to reign supreme. Dark Craft will be available on PC.
